meta.name: pubmed-cli
meta.description: Search PubMed, fetch article metadata, traverse citation graphs, and look up MeSH terms from the command line. Use when: (1) Searching PubMed with Boolean/MeSH queries, (2) Fetching article details by PMID (abstract, authors, DOI, MeSH terms), (3) Finding papers that cite a given article (cited-by), (4) Finding papers cited by a given article (references), (5) Finding related articles with relevance scores, (6) Looking up MeSH vocabulary (tree numbers, scope notes), (7) Exporting citations in RIS format for Zotero/EndNote, (8) Building reproducible literature review workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在命令行检索PubMed文献并导出引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需从终端快速查找生物医学文献并整理引用。
copy.tagline_en: Search PubMed and export citations from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find biomedical literature and manage citations from the terminal.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以直接在终端里搜索 PubMed 文献、获取文章详情（摘要、作者、DOI、MeSH 词等）、查看引用关系（谁引了谁）、查找相似文章、查询 MeSH 词汇，并导出 RIS 格式的引用。
howto.when: 当你需要查找医学文献、获取某篇论文的详细信息、或者梳理文献引用网络时，可以要求 Claude 使用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我搜索最近五年关于自闭症和EEG的综述文章。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回结果列表。

say.text: 查一下PMID 38000001这篇论文的摘要和作者。
say.note: Claude 会获取该文章的详细信息。
Claude 会返回引用该文章的论文列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search PubMed, fetch article details (abstract, authors, DOI, MeSH terms), traverse citation graphs (cited-by, references), find related articles, look up MeSH vocabulary, and export citations in RIS format, all from the command line.
howto.when_en: When you need to search biomedical literature, retrieve details of a specific paper, or explore citation networks, you can ask Claude to use this skill.

say_en.text: Search for review articles on autism and EEG from the last five years.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the search and return results.

say_en.text: Fetch the abstract and authors for PMID 38000001.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve the article details.
Claude will return the citing papers.
